name: web-unlock-guard
description: Stops Claude from retrying a blocked site the same way.

max_strikes.title: Blocks before switching method
max_strikes.description: How many blocked results on the same host and method before the next try with that method is denied.

sites_file.title: Sites registry (optional)
sites_file.description: JSON file with known hosts: tags such as cloudflare, and the route that worked. Laid over the companion skill's bundled sites.json (same host = yours wins). Empty = ~/.config/web-unlock/sites.json.

skill_dir.title: Companion skill folder (optional)
skill_dir.description: Folder of your own web-access skill. If it has lib/detect.mjs, its detector is used; if it has sites.json, that is the bundled registry under yours. Empty = ~/.claude/skills/web-unlock if it exists, else the installed web-unlock plugin's skill.

rules_file.title: Your own rules file (optional)
rules_file.description: JSON file with extra deny rules (regex pattern + message) and extra tool names to watch. Empty = ~/.config/web-unlock-guard/rules.json, which the plugin creates on first run.
